system_name: MachineSense - Industrial Acoustic Fault Diagnosis System

baseline_rf_fan.task: Stage 1 Fan Binary Acoustic Filtering (normal vs anomaly)
baseline_rf_fan.split_strategy: LeaveOneGroupOut (split across machine IDs id_00, id_02, id_04, id_06)

cwru_cnn.task: Bearing & Motor Multi-Class Mechanical Defect Classification
cwru_cnn.dataset: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) Bearing Data Center
cwru_cnn.split_strategy: GroupShuffleSplit (grouped by source recording stem to prevent chunk leakage)

advanced_cnn.task: Stage 2 Fan Log-Mel Spectrogram Anomaly Recognition (Cascade Ensemble)

limitations_and_domain_boundaries.cwru_domain_gap: The CWRU bearing dataset was acquired using contact piezoelectric accelerometers directly mounted on the motor housing. In-field evaluation using non-contact air microphones involves acoustic attenuation, room reverberation, and ambient background noise. The bearing diagnostic model is marked experimental in production UI.
